_comment: Findings adjudicated by a human as correct despite the checker flagging them. Keyed '<identifier>|<canonical name>'. --gate ignores these; the report still lists them so an entry stays visible rather than silently rotting. Two failure modes produce nearly all of them: the citing substance is a member of a chemical SERIES the paper names collectively ('NBOMe derivatives', 'pyrovalerone cathinones', 'fentanyl analogs'), and the checker matching an unrelated substance's alias against a journal name or a MeSH term ('Drug and *Alcohol* Dependence', 'ether', 'serotonin').
_series: the paper names the series, not each member
_named-in-full-text: the compound is in the paper, just not the title or abstract
_comparator: the substance is a reference compound in the paper's own panel
_mechanism-or-metabolite: supports a class/metabolite claim rather than a per-compound number; revisit if the row ever states a substance-specific value
